question: The province view's covert-operations window (open_cov_ops, cov_ops, cov_ops_points, cov_ops_mission_entry) and its allied-cooperation box (set_cooperation, cooperation_list, allied_coop_item, allied_cooperation): what each shows, when, what each posts, and every tooltip.

addresses.name: _A0xb243b455::CCovOpsMissionEntry::CCovOpsMissionEntry
addresses.signature: _A0xb243b455::CCovOpsMissionEntry* __stdcall _A0xb243b455::CCovOpsMissionEntry::CCovOpsMissionEntry(_A0xb243b455::CCovOpsMissionEntry* this@stack:4, CCovertOpsMission* mission@stack:8, int provinceId@stack:0xC, CInGameIdler* screen@ECX) @EAX
addresses.comment: **One row of the province view's covert-operations list** (window `cov_ops_mission_entry`, 0x80 bytes, operator new at 0x6E2F92). 0x6E1DB0 to the `ret 0xC` at 0x6E1FD4. The memory arrives on the stack and **ECX is the in-game screen**, not the row (trap 11): its slot 16 gives the parent and its slot 14 the GUI, whose slot 11 makes the window from the type name; the CStandardlistboxItem base is laid down and then this class's two tables (0x15D4044, 0x15D407C). A CButtonObserverGlue at +0x28 with the handler 0x6E2C10 (OnSelect); mission = +0x78, province id = +0x7C. `selectbutton`'s text is set through its slot 51 to LocaliseObjectKey(mission) - **the mission's key looked up in localisation** (`sabotage_strategic_resource` -> 'Sabotage strategic resource'), no cost; the glue is attached to `selectbutton`; and the row's window is tagged `province_view` (window +0x18, slot 30) so that the province view's tooltip answers its elements. One caller, ProvinceView_FillCovertOpsList (0x6E2FBD).
addresses.evidence: Disassembly 0x6E1DB0-0x6E1FD4: `mov esi,[ebp+8]` (memory), `mov edi,ecx` then `[edi]+0x40`/`[edi]+0x38` calls, `mov [esi+0x78],[ebp+0xc]`, `mov [esi+0x7c],[ebp+0x10]`, `mov eax,0x6e2c10` before the glue constructor 0x6EAFA0, 'selectbutton' + call 0x57F2D0([ebp+0xc]) + `[edx+0xcc]`, 'province_view' + `[edx+0x78]` on `[esi+0x20]+0x18`. Call site 0x6E2FB6-0x6E2FBD pushes province id, mission (edi), memory and loads ECX from the screen local. Wrong if the call site's pushes were in another order - they are read directly.

addresses.name: _A0xb243b455::CCovOpsMissionEntry::Update

Then CCovertOpsMission_CanSelect(mission, province, &player) - **always called** - and `selectbutton` is enabled (slot 46, +0xB8) when both hold and disabled (slot 47, +0xBC) otherwise. Never hidden. Called for every row at the end of ProvinceView_FillCovertOpsList and every frame from ProvinceView_Update while the `cov_ops` window is open.

addresses.name: ProvinceView_FillCovertOpsList
addresses.comment: **`cov_ops_list` made again.** 0x6E2DA0 to the `ret 8` at 0x6E3021; one caller, CProvinceView::OnOpenCovertOps (0x6E1D85). addresses.name: CProvinceView::OnOpenCovertOps

addresses.name: CProvinceView::OnSetCooperation
addresses.comment: **`set_cooperation`: the allied-objectives panel, a toggle.** 0x6E3030 to the bare `ret` at 0x6E35BB. Where `cooperation_list` is shown (its +0x47), it, `cooperation_bg` and `coop_label` are hidden and nothing else happens. Otherwise: the `cov_ops` window is hidden; **the rows are the player's Allies (CCountry +0xF88), in that list's order**, keeping an ally that is in the scenario (+0x44) unless both the player's and the ally's factions (+0xD8) are real (slot 7) and differ; the list is grown with new CAlliedItem rows (0x70 bytes, slot 4) or trimmed (slot 24) to that count; each row is set (CAlliedItem::Set) with the view's province and **ticked where the player has already asked that ally to take this province** - the record for the province id in CGameState +0xBAC[player id] holding the ally's id. Then the list (slot 20), `cooperation_bg` and `coop_label` are shown.

Wrong if +0x47 were not the list's shown byte (inferred from its use as the toggle's state, set by slots 20/21).

addresses.name: ProvinceView_Update
addresses.comment: **The province view's frame update**, as far as read here (the building rows, the weather strip and the underground are brief A's and B's). 0x6E7C00 to the `ret 4` at 0x6E9157 - the next function after BuildProvinceViewTooltip, which abuts it (trap 2). structs.evidence: operator new 0x80 at 0x6E2F92 before the constructor; the primary table 0x15D4044 (RTTI export, 12 slots) written by the constructor at 0x6E1E84.

See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-provinceview.md, section C.

struct_fields.name: mission
struct_fields.comment: The covert operation the row orders. Its key names `selectbutton`, its description heads the tooltip, and OnSelect posts it.
struct_fields.evidence: Constructor `mov [esi+0x78],[ebp+0xc]`, the fill passing the database entry there; Update and BuildTooltip read +0x58/+0x48/+0x88/+0xC8/+0x28 through it; OnSelect pushes it as the command's last argument.

struct_fields.name: province_id
struct_fields.comment: The province the operation would be run in - the view's province id when the list was filled.
struct_fields.evidence: Constructor `mov [esi+0x7c],[ebp+0x10]`, the fill passing `[view+0x24]+0xD0`; BuildTooltip indexes CCurrentGameState +0xB8C with it; Update tests it against 0.

struct_fields.name: country
struct_fields.comment: The ally the row asks: tag at +0x28, id at +0x2C. '---'/0 from the constructor; set by CAlliedItem::Set.
struct_fields.evidence: Constructor `mov [esi+0x28],0x2d2d2d` / +0x2C 0; Set `mov [edi+0x28],[ebp+0xc]; mov [edi+0x2c],[ebp+0x10]`; OnChecked pushes both as the command's country.

struct_fields.name: province
struct_fields.comment: The view's province when the panel was opened; its id (+0xD0) is the command's province.
struct_fields.evidence: Set `mov [edi+0x30],edx` with EDX = view +0x24 at the call site; OnChecked/OnUnchecked read `[[+0x30]+0xd0]`.

struct_fields.name: objective_checkbox
struct_fields.comment: The row's `objective` checkbox (a CCheckBox). Set ticks it by writing its +0x60 and +0x100.
struct_fields.evidence: Constructor stores the result of the window's slot 18 lookup of 'objective' at +0x34 and attaches the glue to its +0x48; Set reads `[edi+0x34]` and writes +0x60/+0x100.

struct_fields.name: country
struct_fields.comment: The country asked to take the province - the objective is set **for** it (CGameState +0xB9C[country id]). Saved as `country`; FINDINGS-fieldmap.md placed the key. The province view puts the ally of the ticked row here.
struct_fields.evidence: Constructor stores [ebp+0xc] at +0x3C and [ebp+0x10] at +0x40; Execute and IsValid test +0x40; CAlliedItem::OnChecked pushes the row's +0x28/+0x2C into those two arguments.

struct_fields.name: requester
struct_fields.comment: The country that asks - the player in the province view. Saved as `requester`.
struct_fields.evidence: Constructor stores [ebp+0x14] at +0x44 and [ebp+0x18] at +0x48; OnChecked pushes CCurrentGameState +0xC30/+0xC34 there; Execute and IsValid test +0x48.

struct_fields.name: province
struct_fields.comment: The province id. Saved as `province`; Execute and IsValid refuse it below 0 (and only below 0).

struct_fields.name: is_valid
struct_fields.comment: `is_valid`, a CAndTrigger held by value. **Asked by the province view**: ProvinceView_FillCovertOpsList lists only the operations whose is_valid is empty or holds (FROM = the player, province = the target), and CCovOpsMissionEntry::Update disables a listed row's button when it stops holding. It is never shown in a tooltip.
struct_fields.revises: The comment said 'Which code asks it was not found here'. It is asked twice, both in the province view: 0x6E2F4A-0x6E2F83 in ProvinceView_FillCovertOpsList (`cmp [edi+0x58],0`, slot 6) and 0x6E20B4-0x6E20F6 in CCovOpsMissionEntry::Update.
struct_fields.evidence: `cmp dword ptr [ecx+0x58],ebx` then `[ecx+0x48]`'s slot 6 (`[edx+0x18]`) at 0x6E20B4-0x6E20F6; the same shape in 0x6E2DA0's loop. +0x58 is +0x48 + 0x10, CTrigger's child count.

notes: For reader A (CProvinceView), read here and **not** put in this fragment so as not to collide: the view's slot 0 (0x6E35C0) binds close_button to the glue at +0x2C (handler +0x34 = 0x6DE340, the in-game screen's ClearSelection), set_cooperation to +0x58 (0x6E3030), open_cov_ops to +0x84 (0x6E1B40), owner_flag and occupier_flag to +0xC4 (0x6EA010), spawn_partisan +0xF0 (0x6E1450), spawn_underground +0x11C (0x6E1460), underground_mission +0x148 (0x6EA380 and 0x6EA490), cgm_underground_build +0x178 (0x6DDCD0). Fields: +0x20 the window, +0x24 the province (CMapProvince*), +0xB0 the allied-objective count last shown (written only by ProvinceView_FillAlliedObjectiveFlags, and **never initialised** - the constructor zeroes +0xAC and +0xB8 but not +0xB0), +0xB4/+0xB8 owner and +0xBC/+0xC0 controller copied by the refresh from CMapProvince +0x32C..+0x338. 0x6E7C00 (ProvinceView_Update) is recorded here because cov_ops_points is set in it; reader A may also record it - if so, keep one name. Window slot 30 (0xAC3620 on the table at 0x1602058) recurses into a window's children, which is how a tag reaches the elements existing at the time of the call.
